name: Gareth's Smithy
anchor_note: origin_px = pixel of the NW corner of world tile (x0,y0) in every layer. Blit at (tile_screen_x(x0) - origin_px.x*TILE/40, tile_screen_y(y0) - origin_px.y*TILE/40), scaled by TILE/40.

layers.name: ground
layers.order: after floor tiles, before entities (cobble apron, yard floor, soot under the lean-to)

layers.name: body
layers.order: y-sorted like an entity standing on world row 18: after entities with y <= 18, before entities with y > 18

layers.name: cutaway
layers.order: replaces body while the local player is inside (floor rect or doorway tiles); walls cut at 1.6 m

glow.note: drop-in replacements for body.png (forge coals, windows and forge light pulse). body.png == body_glow1 look. Same size/origin.

smoke.order: draw right after body (outside view only; skip with cutaway). Already masked behind the chimney. Same size/origin.

legend.G: GRASS walkable strip behind the building (north row, unchanged)
legend.P: WALL south wall row (props stand here)
